consent.first_launch.title: Before you start
consent.first_launch.statement1: Everything I import stays in this browser. Hearth has no account and no server-side copy of my data; if I clear site data without exporting a dump, it is gone.
consent.first_launch.statement2: Hearth is an informational tool, not a medical device. Nothing it shows is a diagnosis or treatment advice; I will talk to a qualified clinician before acting on it.
consent.first_launch.statement3: Knowledge-base text may be wrong or outdated. Where it was generated by a language model it is labelled as such.
consent.first_launch.statement4: I am at least 18 years old.
consent.import_genome.title: Importing a genome
consent.import_genome.statement1: This DNA file is mine, or the person it belongs to has given me their explicit consent to store and analyse it here.
consent.import_genome.statement2: I understand that a genome also reveals information about biological relatives who have not consented.
consent.import_genome.statement3: Direct-to-consumer analysis of genetic data is legal where I live; I am responsible for checking that.
consent.import_minor.title: Adding a person under 18
consent.import_minor.statement1: I am this child's parent or legal guardian.
consent.import_minor.statement2: I have considered that the child may later wish this data had not been analysed, and I will delete it on their request.
consent.import_document.title: Importing a medical document
consent.import_document.statement1: I am entitled to hold this document and to store it here for personal, household use.
consent.tier3_byok.title: Sending questions with my own API key
consent.tier3_byok.statement1: The previewed context pack will be sent directly from this browser to the provider I configure, under that provider's terms and privacy policy.
consent.tier3_byok.statement2: My API key is stored only in this browser.
consent.tier3_byok.statement3: I will still confirm every individual request before it is sent.
consent.read_document_byok.title: Reading documents with my own API key
consent.read_document_byok.statement1: Each document I choose (the image or PDF itself) will be sent directly from this browser to the provider I configure, under that provider's terms and privacy policy.
consent.read_document_byok.statement2: My API key is stored only in this browser. On a free-tier key the provider may use what I send to improve its models; a paid key is needed to prevent that.
consent.read_document_byok.statement3: I will confirm every individual document before it is sent, and review the transcription before it is saved.
consent.backup_folder.title: Backing up to a folder
consent.backup_folder.statement1: Hearth will write a copy of everything, including genetic data, to the folder I choose on this computer, a USB stick, or a folder another program syncs to a cloud drive.
consent.backup_folder.statement2: Whoever can read that folder can read the backup unless I set a passphrase. Losing the passphrase means losing the backup.
consent.backup_folder.statement3: Nothing is sent anywhere by Hearth itself; any syncing is done by the software I installed, under its terms.
consent.cloud_backup.title: Backing up to a cloud drive
consent.cloud_backup.statement1: Hearth will send an encrypted copy of everything, including genetic data, to the cloud account I choose (Google Drive, Dropbox or iCloud Drive), where it is kept under that provider's terms.
consent.cloud_backup.statement2: The copy is encrypted with my passphrase if I set one, and the passphrase stays on this device. Stored unencrypted, anyone who can open that folder can read it. Losing the passphrase means losing an encrypted backup.
consent.cloud_backup.statement3: On Google Drive, Hearth can see my whole Drive so that I can choose the folder, and it reads and writes only the backup files in that folder. On Dropbox it reaches only its own app folder. Forgetting the backup in Settings signs Hearth out.
